title: Mobile Bottom Dock Drag Destination Commitment & Gesture Stability
summary: Permanently eliminates mid-drag and post-drag indicator snapbacks on the mobile bottom navigation bar by eliminating transform clearing timeouts, committing touchcancel to hovered tabs, and adding non-passive touchmove prevention.

changes.text: Permanent Transform Locking: eliminated trailing style.transform clearing timeouts after drag releases, keeping the thumb indicator locked firmly on the destination tab throughout Next.js route loading with zero jump.
TouchCancel Destination Commit: updated touchcancel handling to commit navigation to the actively hovered tab instead of forcibly aborting and resetting the thumb to the start tab.

Non-Passive Touch Event Interception: registered a native non-passive touchmove listener with e.preventDefault() on the navigation dock, preventing mobile Safari and Chrome from triggering native link-drag recognizers.

Synchronous Drag State & Click Suppression: introduced synchronous isDraggingRef to eliminate React render batching race conditions during gestures, and widened trailing synthetic click suppression to 650ms.
